title_en: Psychology Made Simple (6/20): Safe in Mom's Arms
note_en: 孩子知道不管发生什么，妈妈都会在他身边 uses 不管…都…: 不管 "no matter" opens up every possible condition, and 都 in the main clause says the result stays the same in all of them. English "no matter what happens" needs nothing in the second half, but in Chinese leaving out 都 sounds incomplete.
